hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,re,sys;c=json.load(sys.stdin)["tool_input"]["command"];q=lambda s:re.sub(r"[\s\\]+"," ",s);sys.exit(0 if any(re.search(r"(?:^|[^\w-])git(?:\s+-[Cc]\s+\S+|\s+-\S+)*\s+commit(?![\w-])",t) for t in (q(re.sub(r"[\x22\x27]"," ",c)),q(re.sub(r"[\x22\x27]","",c)))) else 3)' 2>/dev/null; if [ $? -eq 3 ]; then exit 0; fi; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$root" ] || [ ! -f "$root/Makefile" ]; then exit 0; fi; cd "$root" || exit 0; out=$(make check 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then { echo "make check красный (код $code) — коммит запрещён, R-9: DoD = зелёный CI.
